title: Amanuensis installer release manifest
description: installer/release.json carries the pinned third-party images and the pinned Node.js runtime. The copy under release/ in the state directory also records the local builds. Values are flat strings so the installer can read them without a JSON tool.

dex_image.description: Login service image, pinned by multi-arch index digest.

mail_email_image.description: Email connector image, pinned by multi-arch index digest.

setup_image.description: Helper image the Windows state commands run against the aman_home volume, pinned by multi-arch index digest.

source_ref.description: Commit of the checkout the local images were built from.

app_image.description: Local tag of the app image built from Dockerfile.dev, aman-app:<source id>.

stt_image.description: Local tag of the speech-to-text image built from ops/aman-stt, aman-stt:<source id>.

calendar_image.description: Local tag of the calendar sidecar image built from ops/calendar-sidecar, aman-calendar-caldav:<source id>.

app_image_digest.description: Digest of the app image downloaded from the registry, empty when it was built here.

stt_image_digest.description: Digest of the speech-to-text image downloaded from the registry, empty when it was built here.

calendar_image_digest.description: Digest of the calendar connector image downloaded from the registry, empty when it was built here.

broker_image.description: Reserved for the sandbox broker, absent until it ships.

sandbox_image.description: Reserved for the sandbox run image, absent until it ships.

sandbox_key_fingerprint.description: Reserved for the sandbox signing key, absent until the broker ships.

node_version.description: Node.js release the installer downloads from nodejs.org to run the sandbox setup when the host has no suitable Node.js (22.14 or newer).

node_sha256_linux_x64.description: SHA-256 of node-v<node_version>-linux-x64.tar.gz, copied from the SHASUMS256.txt that nodejs.org publishes for that release.

node_sha256_linux_arm64.description: SHA-256 of node-v<node_version>-linux-arm64.tar.gz, copied from the SHASUMS256.txt that nodejs.org publishes for that release.

node_sha256_darwin_x64.description: SHA-256 of node-v<node_version>-darwin-x64.tar.gz, copied from the SHASUMS256.txt that nodejs.org publishes for that release.

node_sha256_darwin_arm64.description: SHA-256 of node-v<node_version>-darwin-arm64.tar.gz, copied from the SHASUMS256.txt that nodejs.org publishes for that release.
